text: 当前全球宏观与资本市场环境复杂多变，中欧瑞博投资管理股份公司、董事长兼首席投资官吴伟志认为，短期扰动掩盖了结构性优势。中国经济正经历从“量的扩张”向“质的跃升”的关键切换，中国股市则处于全球配置显著低估、盈利预期改善与政策托底共振的有利窗口。中长期竞争力方面，AI与能源双轮驱动，构筑差异化全球护城河。产业结构方面，制造业压舱石稳固，出口韧性持续强化。从资本市场改革与上市公司质量提升方面来看，当前制度红利与蓝筹业绩共振。从估值与配置层面看，中国股票前瞻估值更便宜，且中国股票资产在MSCI全球指数中的权重显著低于经济体量占比，外资长线基金大幅低配，构成历史性
text_en: In the current complex and rapidly changing global macro and capital market environment, Wu Weizhi, Chairman and Chief Investment Officer of China Europe Ruibo Investment Management Co., Ltd., believes that short-term disturbances are masking structural advantages. The Chinese economy is undergoing a key transition from "quantitative expansion" to "qualitative leap," while the Chinese stock market is in a favorable window of significant undervaluation in global allocation, improving earnings expectations, and policy support. In terms of medium- to long-term competitiveness, AI and energy are dual drivers building a differentiated global moat. In terms of industrial structure, manufacturing serves as a stable ballast, and export resilience continues to strengthen. From the perspective of capital market reform and improvement in the quality of listed companies, current institutional dividends and blue-chip performance are reinforcing each other.
